query: I lost my student ID. How do I get a replacement?
answer: Report your lost ID through the Student portal by navigating to Student services → ID replacement. You will need to upload a recent photograph and pay a demo replacement fee of ₹200. The replacement ID can be collected from the Student Support Office after three working days, along with your application receipt.
sources: Replacing a lost student ID; Student services handbook

query: How do I request a bonafide certificate?
answer: You can request a bonafide certificate by logging into the Student portal, then navigating to Student services → Certificates → Bonafide. Select the purpose of your request and submit it. Certificates are usually ready within two working days.
sources: Requesting a bonafide certificate; Student services handbook
